text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut prototype board to 100 x 70 mm. Drill four 3.2 mm holes 10 mm in

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: from each end and 10 mm in from the long edges (80 x 50 mm apart).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Solder the catalytic sensor under the board, centred 28 mm from the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: left end; the MOS sensor under it 28 mm from the right end, both on

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the long centre line. They must sit over the two ports.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Seat each sensor with 0.8 mm under its body: the catalytic can's face

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: then sits 2.2 mm above its disc. Use a 0.8 mm shim while soldering.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: On top: the bridge supply and heater regulator and a 4-way terminal

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: for the cable (24 V, 0 V, catalytic output, MOS output).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: No flux cleaner or silicone near the sensors: both poison them.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the four holes line up with the standoffs in the box.
